keyword: how to get tickets to the masters

verifications.claim: The annual ticket lottery for Masters tickets is on Masters.com.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'creating a free account on the Masters... official websites'; R3: 'Create your Masters account... at this link'; R4: 'creating an account on the official Masters website'; R5: 'Create your Account... 2027 MASTERS TICKETS'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly reference applying via the official Masters website (Masters.com).

verifications.claim: Applications for Masters tickets for the following year usually open in June.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'applications... open June 1 and close June 20 each year'; R3: 'lottery for 2027 runs June 1-20'; R4: 'submit... between June 1 and June 20'; R5: '2027 Applications Open - June 1st through June 20th'; R6: 'apply... between May 30 and June 20'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm applications open in June for the following year's event.

verifications.claim: There are roughly 2 million applicants for Masters tickets.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions the number of applicants, roughly 2 million or otherwise.

verifications.claim: The chance of winning Masters tickets in the lottery is approximately 0.5%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'you still only have about a 0.5% chance to win the ticket lottery'; 'Forbes.com puts the odds... at 1 in 200. This would be expressed as a 0.5% chance'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states the 0.5% chance multiple times.

verifications.claim: Applications for the official Masters lottery open typically June 1-20.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'open June 1 and close June 20'; R3: 'June 1-20'; R4: 'June 1 and June 20'; R5: 'June 1st through June 20th'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources exactly match the June 1-20 window.

verifications.claim: Winners of the Masters ticket lottery are notified in July.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'inform those who have been selected in late July'; R3: 'payments starting in late July'; R5: 'Payments Open - Late July'; R6: 'notified... around mid- to late July'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state notification in (late) July.

verifications.claim: Practice rounds for the Masters are Mon-Wed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'three days of Practice Rounds'; R6: '$2,000 (Monday/Tuesday)... Wednesday... of the practice days'
verifications.reasoning: R6 explicitly references Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday as practice days; R1 confirms three practice days aligning with standard Mon-Wed.

verifications.claim: Tournament days for the Masters are Thu-Sun.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'four days of Competitive or Tournament Rounds'; R2: 'Thursday, April 8, through Sunday, April 11'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states Thu-Sun; R1 confirms four tournament days.

verifications.claim: Third-party sites like StubHub offer Masters tickets often for $1,200+ per ticket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'saved almost $400 per day on fees I would have had to pay on Stubhub'; R3: 'cheapest ticket... $8,333... $6,000'; R6: '$2,000 (Monday/Tuesday) and closer to $3,000'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm StubHub and other secondary sales at prices well above $1,200.

verifications.claim: Augusta National strictly prohibits resale of Masters tickets.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The resale of any Masters Ticket is strictly prohibited'; R3: 'second-hand site tickets are strictly prohibited'; R5: 'The resale of any Masters Ticket is strictly prohibited'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes from official and reporting sources use 'strictly prohibited'.

verifications.claim: Masters tickets acquired through secondary markets can be voided.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Holders of Tickets acquired from third parties... may be excluded from attendance'; R3: 'will not accept resale tickets'; R5: 'Holders of Tickets acquired from third parties... may be excluded'
verifications.reasoning: Sources state tickets from third parties may result in exclusion, supporting voiding risk.

verifications.claim: Only one entry is allowed per person/household in the Masters ticket lottery.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Applications... limited to one per household'; R6: 'only one entry per residential address'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly limit to one per household/residential address.
